test_title: SSC CHSL Tier-1 2022: Official Paper (Held On: 21 March, 2023 Shift 1)
subject: general
question:
Parts of the following sentence are given as options. Identify the part that contains a grammatical error. If there is no error, select 'No error'.

Such was the education / of the Spartans with regard to / one of the greatest of there kings.

options.text: one of the greatest of there kings.
of the Spartans with regard to

solution:
The correct answer is **'Option 2'.**
